items.name: Stone
items.title: Stone Ore in The Forge: Stats and Location
items.h1: Stone Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Uses
items.desc: Stone ore in The Forge: a Common 1-in-1 drop from Pebbles in Stonewake's Cross, with a 0.2x multiplier, a $3 sell price, and no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Stone is the first Common ore most players pick up in The Forge. It drops from every Pebble in Stonewake's Cross, so it is easy to stock but it has the lowest multiplier of the five ores in this pilot.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles in Stonewake's Cross, the starting area. Multiple sources list Stone's drop chance as a guaranteed 1/1 from those Pebbles, and they do not list it on Rocks or Boulders.
items.uses: Stone has no trait. Its multiplier is 0.2x, the lowest in this set, and it sells for $3. It is early-game filler for forging practice; later ores in this list have higher multipliers. For the mine-forge-sell loop, see the beginner guide and the forging guide.

items.name: Sand Stone
items.title: Sand Stone Ore in The Forge: Stats & Location
items.h1: Sand Stone Ore in The Forge: Chance and Uses
items.desc: Sand Stone in The Forge: a Common 1-in-2 drop from Pebbles and Rocks in Stonewake's Cross, 0.25x multiplier, $3.75 sell price, no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Sand Stone is a Common ore from Stonewake's Cross with a slightly better multiplier and sell price than Stone. It still has no trait, so it is mainly an early mining drop while you work toward Iron and Gold.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles and Rocks in Stonewake's Cross. Sources agree the drop chance is 1/2 from those nodes. They do not list Sand Stone on Boulders.
items.uses: Sand Stone has no trait, a 0.25x multiplier, and a $3.75 sell price. Use it as a small step up from Stone when you forge early weapons or armor, then move on to Copper and Iron as they drop. See the forging guide for how ore multipliers feed item stats.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer

items.name: Copper
items.title: Copper Ore in The Forge: Chance and Uses
items.h1: Copper Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Uses
items.desc: Copper ore in The Forge: Common, 1-in-3 from Pebbles, Rocks and Boulders in Stonewake's Cross, 0.3x multiplier, $4.50 sell price, no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Copper is a Common Stonewake's Cross ore that drops from all three early rock types: Pebbles, Rocks, and Boulders. It has no trait, but its multiplier and sell price sit a step above Sand Stone.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles, Rocks, or Boulders in Stonewake's Cross. Sources agree the drop chance is 1/3 from those nodes.
items.uses: Copper has no trait, a 0.3x multiplier, and a $4.50 sell price. It is a solid early forging ore once you can break the same nodes that also drop Iron. For pickaxe upgrades that reach Boulders, see the pickaxe progression guide.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer

items.name: Iron
items.title: Iron Ore in The Forge: Stats and Location
items.h1: Iron Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Uses
items.desc: Iron ore in The Forge: Common, 1-in-5 from Pebbles, Rocks and Boulders in Stonewake's Cross, 0.35x multiplier, $5.25 sell price, no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Iron is the strongest Common ore in this starter set. It comes from the same Stonewake's Cross nodes as Copper, with a lower drop chance and a slightly higher multiplier.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles, Rocks, or Boulders in Stonewake's Cross. Sources agree the drop chance is 1/5 from those nodes.
items.uses: Iron has no trait, a 0.35x multiplier, and a $5.25 sell price. Among the four Common ores in this pilot, it is the best raw multiplier for early weapons and armor. See the forging guide and the beginner guide for how to use early ores in the crafting loop.

items.name: Gold
items.title: Gold Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Price
items.h1: Gold Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Price
items.desc: Gold ore in The Forge: Uncommon, 1-in-16 from Boulders in Stonewake's Cross, 0.65x multiplier, $19.50 sell price, and no trait. See the full stats!
items.lead: Gold is the Uncommon ore in this starter set. Sources agree it drops from Boulders in Stonewake's Cross at 1-in-16, with a 0.65x multiplier and a $19.50 sell price — high for that multiplier — and no trait.
items.how_to_get: Mine Boulders in Stonewake's Cross. Game8, Destructoid, BloxInformer, and the official Forge Wiki all list a 1/16 drop chance from Boulders there.
items.uses: Gold has no trait and a 0.65x multiplier, higher than the Common ores in this list. Its confirmed sell price is $19.50, which is high compared with nearby ores that have similar or higher multipliers. Our money guide still generally recommends forging ores into gear rather than selling the raw ore. For reaching Boulders, see pickaxe progression.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer
unverified: The official Forge Wiki Gold page also lists Forgotten Kingdom (Basalt Rock). Game8 (February 22, 2026), Destructoid (January 8, 2026), and BloxInformer list only Boulders in Stonewake's Cross. We do not treat Forgotten Kingdom or Basalt Rock as confirmed.
